about.bio1: From Triathlete to Fitness Coach, I live and breathe sports in the south of England. My passion for running quickly led me to the world of endurance racing, starting with completing a challenging Ironman 70.3 and a Full Ironman.

To combine the discipline of an Ironman with the science of fitness so that you can achieve your best physical and mental shape.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data EZ Training Hub collects, why, and what you can do about it. It covers the public site, the coach portal and the athlete app.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
body: The data controller is [CONTROLLER NAME], [ADDRESS].
For any question or request about your data, write to [CONTACT EMAIL].

sections.title: What we collect
body: Account: name, email, profile photo (optional), your role in the app (athlete or coach) and training plan details.
Training: the workouts assigned to you and what you log when you finish them, such as time, distance, pace, heart rate, loads, reps, perceived effort and notes.
Communication: chat messages with the coach and the team, posts, comments and likes in the feed, and the events and races you add.
Notifications: if you allow them, a device identifier to send push notifications.
Site usage: only if you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics records the pages you visit, device and browser type and an approximate location.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To provide the coaching: build and adjust your workouts, follow your progress and talk to you.
To send the notices you asked for, such as reminders and messages from the coach.
To keep the app safe and working, for example to recognise your sign-in.
With your consent, to understand how the site is used and improve it.

sections.title: Legal basis
body: We use your data to deliver the coaching service you signed up for, with your consent (usage analytics and notifications) and to keep the service secure. [CONFIRM THE LEGAL BASES AND APPLICABLE LAWS WITH LEGAL ADVICE.]

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: We don't sell your data. We use providers that process data on our behalf:

Google Firebase (sign-in, database, photo storage and notifications); Google Analytics (only if you accept); Vercel (site hosting); Cloudinary (post images); YouTube (videos on the site, which only load when you press play).
These providers may store data outside your country. [CONFIRM STORAGE LOCATIONS AND TRANSFER SAFEGUARDS.]

sections.title: Cookies and storage on your device
body: Necessary: we keep your language, theme, sign-in session and a copy of your data in your browser so the app works offline. The app doesn't work without them.
Analytics: Google Analytics cookies are only used if you accept them in the cookie notice. You can change your choice at any time in "Cookie preferences" in the footer.

YouTube: videos on the site show only an image until you press play. When you play one, it loads in YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com), and YouTube may record data under its own policy.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep your data while your account is active and for [RETENTION PERIOD] after the coaching ends, unless you ask us to delete it sooner.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct, copy or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to [CONTACT EMAIL]. We reply within [RESPONSE TIME].

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: When this policy changes, we update the date at the top of the page and, for important changes, let you know in the app.

meta.title: Raise Your Hands — Cycling with purpose from north to south of Portugal

hero.title: Cycling with purpose from north to south of Portugal
hero.lead: Much more than a challenge of physical endurance and pushing your limits. A crossing from Porto to Faro driven by faith, connecting communities and bringing food, hope and direct support to families in vulnerable situations.

purpose.title: What is the Raise Your Hands project?
purpose.p1: Conceived by Edgar Alan Zanin, {{name}} was born from the conviction that long-distance sport can be a powerful tool for social and spiritual transformation.
purpose.p2: During the crossing through the interior and the coast of Portugal, each stop goes far beyond physical rest. In partnership with local churches, fire brigades and charities, we identify families, elderly people and others going through difficult times — whether due to health problems, unemployment or isolation.
purpose.quote: {{name}} is an invitation to raise your hands in gratitude and faith and, above all, to reach out a hand to help those most in need along the way.
purpose.photoPlaceholder: [PHOTO: stop / food delivery, no identifiable faces without consent]

route.title: The crossing: from Porto to Faro
route.sub: A demanding journey along the roads and mountains of Portugal, facing steep climbs, strong winds and changing weather to complete each stage of the mission.

kpis.label: crossing the country from north to south

route.mapLabel: Route from Porto to Faro, 7 stages

transparency.title: Commitment and full transparency
transparency.sub: Every cent donated turns directly into food on the table of those in need.

pillars.title: 100% Turned into Food
pillars.body: All the trip's logistics costs — including accommodation, fuel and the team's meals — are covered entirely with our own resources. Donations go exclusively to buying groceries at local supermarkets.

pillars.title: Connection with Local Networks
pillars.body: We work side by side with community leaders, pastors and social organisations in the towns and cities along the route (such as Gaia, Chaves and Castro Daire) to make sure help reaches those who truly need it in a discreet and respectful way.

pillars.title: Open Accountability
pillars.body: All purchases and invoices are recorded and shared publicly in the expedition vlogs, ensuring full clarity about where each contribution goes.

stories.title: People we met along the way
stories.sub: More than the kilometres travelled, what marks this journey are the lives touched at every stop.

items.title: Support in Vila Nova de Gaia and Chaves
items.body: Deliveries of full grocery shops to families and mothers in vulnerable situations, carried out with the support of the local community.

items.title: Partnership with the Church and Fire Brigade
items.body: Together with local leaders, we brought groceries and words of encouragement to couples facing serious health problems after returning from abroad.

items.title: Solidarity in the Interior
items.body: Arriving in small villages during weather warnings, we met a visually impaired father raising his three children on his own — and we were able to stock his home with essential groceries.

cta.title: Be part of this mission
cta.body: You don't need to cycle almost 900 kilometres to transform a family's life. You can boost this project by supporting our next routes, sharing the videos or sending a message of encouragement.

footer.byline: — A project by Edgar Alan Zanin.
footer.tagline: Faith, Long-Distance Cycling and Social Action.

fundraising.title: Where the money came from
fundraising.via: Received through the JustGiving campaign and direct donations.
fundraising.story: Raise your hands! Last year, in 2025, our faith was taken to another level. Around September, while living in Portugal, we faced financial difficulties. We had enough to pay our bills, but we didn’t have money to put food on the table. We lifted our hands and prayed for God’s provision — and He answered.
fundraising.storyRest:
He sent a missionary family who blessed us with food for an entire month. Then, He sent others who continued to provide food and even some financial help. Through that experience, we understood something powerful: God is our provider.

This year, we want to be that blessing for others. We’ll be cycling from the North to the South of Portugal, supporting families in need. You can be part of this mission! We’re raising funds to help families in several cities — Porto, Chaves, Vila de Rei, Viana do Alentejo, and Faro. I’ll be cycling roughly 1,000 km across Portugal to bring hope and help where it’s needed most.

I’ll be recording everything on YouTube — from the very start of this page, through the training and preparation, to the full north-to-south cycling journey. You’ll see exactly where every donation goes and how you’re helping transform lives. Come and be part of it. Together, let’s be a blessing to families across Portugal!
